decisive_spans.text: a 70 × 60 × 60 mm left ovarian cyst first noted at 5 weeks and thought to be endometriotic

response.rationale: The vignette explicitly states the ovarian cyst was "thought to be endometriotic" and there was a significant rise in CRP, which supports rupture. While D3 (Ovarian cyst rupture with peritonitis) is also supported by rising inflammatory markers and peritoneal irritation, D5 (Endometriotic cyst rupture) is more specific given the known nature of the cyst.
